newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT REBOUNDS VS DLR, EASES VS BASKET.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT REBOUNDS VS DLR, EASES VS BASKET.

text.p: Hungary's forint regained some of its losses against the dollar despite weakening against the currency basket as the mark rebounded against the U.S. currency in the afternoon, dealers said.
The forint finished at 155.55/60, up from 155.65/70 at noon but still down from 155.48/53 at the opening.
"The forint firmed because the dollar fell against the mark," said Inter-Europa Bank's Ervin Csengeri.
The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
The forint closed some 10 fillers weaker than the National bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level (bid), compared with a five pip differential at midday.
Dealers said minor foreign currency buyings caused the forint to move inside the 4.5 percent wide NBH intervention bans in lacklustre trade.

Dollar futures closed mainly firmer on the Budapest Commodity Exchange, where the trading floor operates only in the morning. Most mark maturities remained stable, almost all Ecu futures were steady, while yen futures were unchanged or weaker. -- Sandor Peto, Budapest newsroom (36 1) 327 4040
